Local vendoring notice (2026-10-31)

Package: @jitsi/rnnoise-wasm 0.2.1
Jitsi source: https://github.com/jitsi/rnnoise-wasm/tree/cb529a59a8478fe604e57986fc96afdaecfa6fb7
RNNoise source: https://github.com/xiph/rnnoise/tree/372f7b4b76cde4ca1ec4605353dd17898a99de38

rnnoise-sync.mjs is byte-for-byte package/dist/rnnoise-sync.js from the npm
release. Only the filename extension was changed so Node can load the upstream
ES module directly. Its embedded WASM is unchanged. No CDN or remote runtime
dependency is used. PROVENANCE.json records the official npm SHA512 integrity,
SHA1, source commits, asset SHA256 values and embedded WASM SHA256.

The Jitsi wrapper is Apache-2.0 (LICENSE.apache-2.0.txt). RNNoise and bundled
components carry the redistribution terms in COPYING.rnnoise.txt and source
headers; these notices are retained. Upstream README/package/build files and
small pinned RNNoise source/header files are preserved for reproducibility.
The upstream build script is reference material only and is never executed.

The sync artifact is RNNoise 0.2; the async artifact in this same release is an
older RNNoise 0.1 build and is intentionally not used.

Delay audit: denoise.upstream.h defines FRAME_SIZE=480 and WINDOW_SIZE=960.
denoise.upstream.c uses one analysis overlap frame plus delayed_X. A direct
embedded-WASM impulse at input sample 4873 peaks at output sample 5833: delay
960 samples (20 ms at 48 kHz). The adapter flushes two zero frames, discards
the leading 960 samples and returns the original sample count. This is offline
alignment, not a zero-latency claim; filtering may smear or change transients.

Input to RNNoise is normalized PCM multiplied by 32768; output is divided by
32768, with only out-of-range output clipped and counted. No gain normalization
is applied. RNNoise changes the waveform and may remove useful speech. Neither
noise attenuation nor its internal VAD represents speech-recognition accuracy.

Core PCM bound: 180 seconds / 8,640,000 mono Float32 samples / 34,560,000 bytes.
A separate 20 MiB encoded input-file limit belongs to the comparison UI. The
larger decoded PCM bound is needed because Float32 at 48 kHz is 192,000 B/s.
